## Checklist
- [ ] **Both READMEs in sync** — a change to `README.md` is mirrored in `README.zh-CN.md` (and vice versa).
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, Clippy, and `cargo test --locked` pass.
- [ ] Concurrent writes, ETags, role permissions, and hook merging remain covered when affected.
- [ ] Docs describe actual host scope, especially project-scoped Codex hooks.
- [ ] **No secrets / machine-local detail** in examples, templates, or memory.
- [ ] **CHANGELOG.md updated** if this is a user-visible change.
